description: This Java class 'RenderPreview' manages the rendering and display of layout previews within the Android Studio environment, including thumbnail generation, rendering, user interactions, and visual styling for layout configurations.

classes.name: RenderPreview
classes.description: Manages the rendering, display, and interaction of layout previews in Android Studio, including thumbnail creation, rendering, user input handling, and visual styling.

methods.name: computeInitialSize
methods.description: Calculates initial size parameters based on device screen and orientation.

methods.name: computeFullSize
methods.description: Determines full device size considering device hardware and orientation.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Recomputes size based on current device configuration.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the configuration used for this preview.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the current scale factor for the thumbnail.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the scale factor for the thumbnail, if zoom support is enabled.

methods.name: getAspectRatio
methods.description: Returns the aspect ratio of the preview.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the preview is actively hovered.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the hover state of the preview.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the preview is currently visible.

methods.name: isForked
methods.description: Determines if the preview represents a forked layout or separate file.

methods.name: getAlternateInput
methods.description: Returns the file used as alternate input for rendering.

methods.name: getArea
methods.description: Calculates the area of the preview before scaling.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the preview, triggering rendering or disposal.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the layout position of the preview.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the X position of the preview.

methods.name: getY
methods.description: Returns the Y position of the preview.

methods.name: updateForkStatus
methods.description: Updates whether the preview is a better match for a different layout file.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new RenderPreview instance.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources and cancels pending rendering jobs.

methods.name: disposeThumbnail
methods.description: Disposes of thumbnail images.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the preview.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Overrides the display name of the preview.

methods.name: setIncludedWithin
methods.description: Sets the outer layout reference if this layout is included within another.

methods.name: renderSync
methods.description: Performs synchronous rendering of the preview.

methods.name: tryRenderSync
methods.description: Attempts to render synchronously, returning success status.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Returns the thumbnail image, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: createThumbnail
methods.description: Generates a thumbnail image from the full render.

methods.name: createRetinaThumbnail
methods.description: Creates a high-resolution (Retina) thumbnail if supported.

methods.name: createErrorThumbnail
methods.description: Creates a placeholder image indicating a rendering error.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Calculates scale based on image and max size.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the scaled width of the preview.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the scaled height of the preview.

methods.name: getLayoutWidth
methods.description: Returns the desired layout width before scaling.

methods.name: getLayoutHeight
methods.description: Returns the desired layout height before scaling.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Handles click events within the preview, including actions like delete, zoom, and rename.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Paints the preview image and UI elements at specified position.

methods.name: paintTitle
methods.description: Paints the title bar of the preview, including name and icons.

methods.name: configurationChanged
methods.description: Updates the preview when configuration changes occur.
